stage: rc2-meta STAGE 1 — shared header-span signature resolver
implemented: Added crates/tldr-core/src/ast/entity.rs (NEW) with a minimal Span and an AST-driven signature_from_header(node, source) that renders a declaration's signature from its HEADER span (name + params + return type), stopping at the body block (body field, else known block kinds: statement_block/block/function_body/compound_statement/do_block/field_declaration_list). Registered the module in ast/mod.rs. Routed two of the three signature producers through it: (a) structure's collect_definitions signature site (extractor.rs ~L2835) now uses signature_from_header for function-axis declarations (is_func && !is_class), keeping the legacy first-line slice for class-axis (no class-signature churn); (b) interface's extract_ts_signature (interface.rs ~L1228) now delegates to signature_from_header, fixing the `(): : void` double-colon mangle and adding the method name. (c) extract.rs uses STRUCTURED params/return_type fields (no flat signature string) and was already correct — left untouched (verified: extract Qux.m yields name=m, params=[], return_type=void which reconstructs to `m(): void`).
edit_set_scope: All edits within the authorized Stage-1 edit-set. No classify_node, no kind enum, no struct collapse (those are Stage 2+).
ast_driven: Spans pinned via tree-sitter node fields/children (child_by_field_name("body"), child kind scan). No regex, no source-text trimming heuristics beyond first-line clipping for legacy multi-line parity.

preexisting_red.evidence: Reverted interface.rs to HEAD (git show HEAD), rebuilt, ran the test in isolation: FAILS identically (`Application` function-declaration missing (got [\"create\"])). Restored Stage-1 version. The failure is a JS prototype-assignment NAME extraction gap, orthogonal to signature rendering; my edit only changes the signature STRING.

rebaseline_note: ZERO goldens required re-baselining. The structure method_infos golden asserts signature DISTINCTNESS (not exact strings); interface goldens assert method NAMES / contains() not exact signature equality. The fix is surgical: only inline-body single-line declarations change (`m(): void {} }` -> `m(): void`); multi-line headers are byte-identical to the legacy first-line slice. No NAME/LINE/KIND change in any golden.
blast_radius: structure: function-axis signatures with an inline body on the declaration line lose the leaked body text. interface (TS/JS only): method/function signatures now render name+params+return via the header span instead of params+return-with-double-colon. Other-language interface signatures are UNCHANGED (only extract_ts_signature was routed; per-language specialized extractors for Scala/Swift/OCaml/etc. untouched — consistent with the staged TS-first plan). extract: untouched. No file outside the authorized edit-set was needed.
